{{unknown name}} [[File:J henchmen.png|thumb|250px|J's henchmen]] [[File:J henchmen DP020.png|thumb|left|220px|J's first set of henchmen]] '''J's henchmen''' are men who help [[J|Pokémon Hunter J]] in her crimes. They first appeared in ''[[DP020|Mutiny in the Bounty!]]''. Only two of J's henchmen are shown to have their own {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. These particular henchmen catalogue all of the Pokémon J has stolen. One of them used a {{p|Golbat}} to {{pkmn|battle}} [[Ash's Pikachu]] before {{Ash}}, [[Jessie]], and [[James]] attempted to sneak off J's airborne base after rescuing Pikachu, {{TRT}}'s {{MTR}}, and [[Melodi]]'s {{p|Gardevoir}}. Some of these henchmen were captured by [[Officer Jenny]] at the end of their first appearance. The ones that weren't captured appeared in ''[[DP045|Ill-Will Hunting!]]''. In this episode, the other important henchman appeared, also using a Golbat to fight Pikachu. These same henchmen reappeared in ''[[DP071|Pokémon Ranger and the Kidnapped Riolu! Part 1]]'' and ''[[DP072|Part 2]]'', where more of their Pokémon appeared. They appeared once more in ''[[DP129|Pillars of Friendship!]]'', with even more of their Pokémon. The henchmen made a brief appearance in ''[[DP151|The Needs of the Three!]]'' alongside J after her successful mission to capture {{DL|Lake guardians (anime)|Mesprit}}, {{DL|Lake guardians (anime)|Azelf}}, and {{DL|Lake guardians (anime)|Uxie}}. They were aboard her ship when it was destroyed by the {{an|lake guardians}}.
